Dependencies bundled for offline play (downloaded 2026-11-25):
- Three.js r128: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js
  MIT license: THREE-LICENSE.txt. The original project already used r128.
- Press Start 2P: https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Press+Start+2P
  SIL Open Font License: PRESS-START-2P-OFL.txt
- VT323: https://fonts.google.com/specimen/VT323
  SIL Open Font License: VT323-OFL.txt
No CDN requests are needed at runtime.
